Delete a Websets monitor
Copy page

Deletes a monitor.

DELETE
/
v0
/
monitors
/
{id}
Try it
Authorizations
apiKey
bearer
apiKey
​
x-api-key
stringheaderrequired

Pass your Exa API key in the x-api-key header. You can also authenticate with Authorization: Bearer .

Path Parameters
​
id
stringrequired

The id of the Monitor

Response
200 - application/json

Monitor deleted successfully

​
id
stringrequired

The unique identifier for the Monitor

​
object
enum<string>required

The type of object

Available options: monitor 
​
status
enum<string>required

The status of the Monitor

Available options: enabled, disabled 
​
websetId
stringrequired

The id of the Webset the Monitor belongs to

​
cadence
objectrequired

How often the monitor will run

Show child attributes

​
behavior
objectrequired

Behavior to perform when monitor runs

Show child attributes

​
lastRun
MonitorRun · object | nullrequired

The last run of the monitor

Show child attributes

​
nextRunAt
string<date-time> | nullrequired

Date and time when the next run will occur in

​
metadata
objectrequired

Set of key-value pairs you want to associate with this object.

Show child attributes

​
createdAt
string<date-time>required

When the monitor was created

​
updatedAt
string<date-time>required

When the monitor was last updated
